After closing the task-local tab and opening a new tab to the same file: URL, fixed text was absent and default status returned.
At increased Chrome zoom, navigation, capture heading, status and content remained available; visual record confirms readable hierarchy.
Restricted/offline page disclosed no reading/processing/generation, no network/sync, and AI not enabled.
No navigation left the task-local file: URLs; no HTTP, network, CDP, command-line browser, persistence or security-warning bypass was used.
